sections.title: Welcome
sections.content:
# Welcome to the Company

We're excited to have you join our team! This handbook contains important information about our policies, culture, and expectations.

## Getting Started

- Review all sections carefully
- Complete your profile information
- Set up your equipment
- Attend orientation sessions

**Important**: Please acknowledge that you've read and understood this handbook.

sections.title: Code of Conduct
sections.content:
## Code of Conduct ### Our Values 1. **Integrity**: Act with honesty and transparency 2. **Respect**: Treat everyone with dignity 3. **Excellence**: Strive for quality in all work 4. **Collaboration**: Work together effectively ### Expected Behavior - Maintain professional communication - Respect diverse perspectives - Follow security protocols - Report concerns promptly
Note: Violations may result in disciplinary action.

sections.title: Benefits & Perks
sections.content:
## Benefits Package

### Health & Wellness

- Medical, dental, and vision insurance
- Mental health support
- Gym membership reimbursement
- Wellness programs

### Time Off

- 20 days PTO annually
- 10 paid holidays
- Sick leave
- Parental leave

### Professional Development

- Annual learning budget: **$2,000**
- Conference attendance
- Internal training programs
- Mentorship opportunities
